title: fact-checking: P0 research subskill 3/9 + control 21 (claim status <-> evidence, earned by failing-first)
objective: Build the fact-checking research subskill (mirroring repository-research/problem-framing): an R10 declarative workflow that adjudicates claim status over already-bound evidence, reusing the frozen statuses and derived confidence, with invariants NO EVIDENCE != FALSE, NO CONTRADICTION != VERIFIED, CITATION != SUPPORT. Add control 21 ONLY because a failing-first probe earned it: FALSIFIED/DISPUTED claims currently pass with no contradicting evidence. Register IMPLEMENTED; badf-research stays DESIGNED (3 of 9 P0).
business_value: fact-checking is the reusable verification primitive for every multi-source route; a claim's status becomes a function of evidence rather than researcher judgment, and 'no evidence is not falsification' becomes a deterministic refusal. It does not own source acquisition -- that is deep-research -- so the ordering fact-checking -> evidence-synthesis -> deep-research -> control 6 stays intact.
in_scope: skills/badf-research/subskills/fact-checking/SKILL.md (concise, declarative; scope boundary: adjudicates bound evidence, does not acquire)
